scope: The June 2009 exterior of the Griffith Mansion in Yolo, California. Includes the 1886 Italianate main house, its porch, polygonal bays, attached side range and rear addition. Detached buildings, private grounds and interiors are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: Principal entrance elevation with two projecting polygonal bays, deep white cornice, paired tall sash windows, white Corinthian columns, covered side verandah and a second-floor rail.
View from the garden confirms the rear two-story wing, the white siding, paneled eaves, side-window alignment and simple dark sash. The landscape and detached objects are excluded.
Exterior capital close view confirms leaf-like Corinthian capitals, scrolled trim and the layered cornice over the entry. Motifs are simplified in the geometry.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s published originals were checked first. The uploader Gregciro identifies himself as GT1886 in the native first-party releases. The front and rear views additionally carry Wikimedia permission ticket 2009121710074191. The unlabeled origin of the two Qualla aerial views leaves their authorship uncertain, so neither was used for geometry or color. The independent federal NAIP map supplies the site registration.
